tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderer should submit their each samples, after the tender closing but before the opening of technical bid without fail
All terms & conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN CARD, GST and Company Registration Certificate
Authorized Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) / Authorized Dealer

Tenderer has supplied & erected satisfactorily Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 50% of the quantity required, to any other reputed organization during last five financial year. If yes, documentary evidence for the same to be uploaded along with the technical bid.
Client list and past work orders with satisfactorily work done certificate
Tenderer should submit their each samples, after the tender closing but before the opening of technical bid without fail.
TDS declaration form uploaded with seal and signature
Latest Income Tax return and GSTR 3B monthly filed document
last 3 years financial Turn Over duly certified & signed by Chartered Accountant
